Driven in snow-free climates other than a 13-month period between 2022 and 2023, during which time an underbody coating applied. Clean underbody with minimal to no rust. Working AHC. Driven "off-road" on farms or dirt roads less than 10 times. Working power seats, sunroof, windows, doors, and locks. Working air conditioning. I bought the OEM pump to replace, and serpentine belt since it has to be taken off anyway, but haven't gotten around to it yet). Minor accident reported in 2002 by the original owner.

Oil and filter every 5000 miles, tires rotated every 10000 miles.

Airbags inspected (174000, January 2024)
Battery replaced in April 2024 (Super Start Extreme with 3 year warranty from O'Rielly)

Through the Parks Plus program, this vehicle also includes added ownership protections such as exterior and interior surface protection, VIN etching anti-theft security, roadside assistance enhancements, ID theft protection and restoration services, and additional long-term ownership benefits designed to help protect your investment.

It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display. Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.Technology and Telematics Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. The 2021 Toyota 4Runner Venture finished in Super White is a rugged and capable midsize SUV designed for both everyday driving and adventurous off-road journeys. The crisp, clean Super White exterior gives this 4Runner a bold and timeless look, while its strong, muscular body lines and elevated stance reflect the vehicles confidence and capability. Whether youre navigating city streets, cruising on the highway, or exploring dirt roads and scenic trails, this 4Runner makes a striking first impression with its purposeful design and iconic presence.

Under the hood, the 2021 4Runner Venture delivers dependable and robust performance. Its powerful engine provides confident acceleration and strong low-end torque, making it easy to merge into traffic, tow gear for camping trips, or climb steep grades with authority. Built on a rugged body-on-frame platform, the 4Runner feels solid and composed on pavement, yet is equally ready for off-pavement challenges thanks to its proven suspension, excellent ground clearance, and capable 4 4 system (if equipped). This combination of strength and versatility is a hallmark of the 4Runner name.

Inside, the cabin offers a comfortable and practical space designed for everyday use and extended road trips alike. The 4Runner Venture provides generous headroom and legroom for front and rear passengers, and the supportive seating helps keep everyone comfortable throughout the journey. Easy-to-reach controls and a clean dashboard layout make the driving experience intuitive, while durable materials stand up well to the demands of active lifestyles.

The technology features in the 4Runner Venture help keep you connected and entertained on the go. A centrally located touchscreen display serves as the hub for audio and connectivity, and Bluetooth connectivity allows for hands-free calling and wireless music streaming. Available USB ports help keep your devices charged and ready for the days adventures. Whether youre listening to your favorite music on the way to work or navigating to a trailhead for a weekend getaway, the 4Runners tech amenities help make every trip more enjoyable.

Cargo space is another strength of the 4Runner. Its roomy rear cargo area makes it easy to transport gear, luggage, sports equipment, and outdoor essentials. The wide cargo opening and sturdy load floor provide practicality for everyday errands as well as for packing gear for camping, biking, or other outdoor activities. The rear seats can also fold down to accommodate larger or bulkier items, giving you even more flexibility.

Safety is an important consideration in the 2021 4Runner Venture, and this SUV comes equipped with a suite of driver-assist features to help enhance your confidence behind the wheel. From traction-enhancing systems to stability control and advanced airbag protection, these thoughtful safety elements work together to help support you and your passengers on every ride whether in busy traffic or on winding mountain roads.

Overall, the 2021 Toyota 4Runner Venture in Super White offers a well-rounded mix of rugged capability, everyday comfort, practical cargo space, user-friendly technology, and confident performance. Its an SUV built for drivers who want a vehicle thats ready for daily life, weekend escapes, and outdoor adventures all wrapped in a capable and reliable package thats as comfortable cruising city streets as it is tackling rugged terrain.

Under the hood, this Sport Touring model features a refined hybrid powertrain that delivers smooth and responsive performance while prioritizing fuel efficiency. The hybrid system seamlessly combines electric power with a gasoline engine to help optimize fuel economy without sacrificing capability. The result is confident acceleration in a variety of driving conditions and enjoyable performance that feels composed and poised in city traffic, on winding roads, or during longer highway journeys.

Inside, the cabin of the CR-V Hybrid Sport Touring is spacious, comfortable, and designed with thoughtful amenities that enhance every ride. Premium materials and refined finishing touches create an inviting atmosphere for both driver and passengers. The supportive seats often wrapped in leather or high-quality upholstery help keep everyone comfortable on short commutes or long road trips. With generous headroom and legroom for all occupants, this SUV provides a relaxing and comfortable environment no matter the distance.

Technology and connectivity are standout features in the Sport Touring trim. A large, intuitive touchscreen display anchors the dashboard and brings entertainment, connectivity, and vehicle controls together in one easy-to-use interface. With Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, you can easily integrate your smartphone for hands-free calls, music streaming, navigation, and more. A premium audio system helps elevate your listening experience, while additional connectivity features and USB ports help keep devices powered and ready throughout the journey.

Practicality is another strength of the CR-V Hybrid Sport Touring. The generous cargo area provides plenty of room for groceries, luggage, outdoor gear, or any everyday essentials you carry. Thoughtful design elements such as folding rear seats and a wide rear opening make loading and organizing cargo easy and convenient. Whether youre running errands or heading out on a weekend adventure, the versatile cargo space adapts to your needs.

Safety and driver-assist technologies are key highlights of this Certified model. Equipped with Hondas suite of advanced safety features, the CR-V helps support your confidence behind the wheel. Features like adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, collision mitigation braking, blind-spot monitoring, and rear cross-traffic alert are designed to help enhance awareness and provide added peace of mind on every trip. These smart systems work together to help you stay aware of your surroundings and assist in challenging driving scenarios.

Being a Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this 2023 Honda CR-V Hybrid Sport Touring has undergone a thorough inspection and meets high standards for quality and reliability. The certification process offers additional reassurance with extended coverage and benefits that help make ownership even more satisfying.

Overall, the Certified 2023 Honda CR-V Hybrid Sport Touring in Crystal Black Pearl delivers an outstanding combination of stylish design, efficient hybrid performance, comfortable interior space, intuitive technology, and advanced safety features. Its a versatile SUV thats ready for daily commuting, family outings, and weekend explorations providing comfort, capability, and confidence mile after mile.

The rear-wheel-drive platform, sport suspension tuning, ZF premium electric rack-and-pinion steering, and Brembo front performance brakes create a driving experience that is both composed and responsive.

The Cadillac User Experience system with embedded navigation integrates seamlessly with the Bose Centerpoint 13-speaker surround sound system, wireless charging capability, Bluetooth connectivity, and a 5.7-inch driver information display.

Safety and driver assistance features include Forward Collision Alert, Lane Change Alert, Following Distance Indicator, Rear Parking Assist, rearview camera, multiple advanced airbag systems including knee airbags, and Cadillac Connected Access technology.

As a Blue Certified vehicle, this CTS has passed a comprehensive multi-point inspection and includes manufacturer-backed limited warranty coverage and roadside assistance, providing added peace of mind beyond a traditional used vehicle purchase.

Through the Parks Plus program, this vehicle also includes additional ownership protections such as exterior and interior surface protection, VIN etching anti-theft security, roadside assistance enhancements, ID theft protection services, and other long-term ownership benefits designed to help safeguard your investment.

If you are searching in the Tampa Bay area for a rear-wheel-drive luxury sport sedan with turbocharged performance, premium audio, and upscale interior materials - without stepping into European maintenance costs - this CTS deserves serious consideration.
